text: 市场消息称，第八代五粮液批价近日持续上行，引发市场广泛关注。在第三方报价平台上注意到，自8月4日起，第八代五粮液市场批价迎来明显跳涨，单瓶价格从前期730元攀升至745元。与此同时，国内多省市市场价格同步走高，有市场消息显示，河南、河北、上海、四川、山东等市场的第八代五粮液批价已集体突破760元/瓶，单周最高涨幅超30元/瓶。针对价格上涨，有四川的渠道商表示，主要系公司渠道政策出现部分调整，但明确并非停货。（每经网）
text_en: Market sources say that the wholesale price of the 8th generation Wuliangye has been rising continuously recently, attracting widespread market attention. On third-party quotation platforms, it was noted that since August 4, the market wholesale price of the 8th generation Wuliangye has seen a noticeable jump, climbing from 730 yuan to 745 yuan per bottle. Meanwhile, prices in multiple domestic provinces and cities have risen simultaneously, with market news showing that wholesale prices in Henan, Hebei, Shanghai, Sichuan, Shandong and other markets have collectively exceeded 760 yuan per bottle, with a weekly maximum increase of over 30 yuan per bottle. In response to the price rise, a channel distributor in Sichuan said it is mainly due to certain adjustments in the company's channel policies, but clarified it is not a supply halt. (MEIJING)
